Card Q&A.q: A Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and an opponent’s Digimon are deleted simultaneously. Does this card’s inherited effect activate?
Can I digivolve this Digimon to a [Gallantmon] in my hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated if my opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon?

Effect: [Your Turn] While your opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon, this Digimon can digivolve into [Gallantmon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted, ＜Draw 1＞.
